comment: Voiceover script for the marketing video, wording and pausing set by the project owner. Order defines scene order. `clip` names the recorded footage (from record.mjs; an externally produced .mp4 with the same scene name wins over a missing .webm), `min`/`max` bound the scene length in seconds; the assembler stretches each scene to fit its narration. Optional `say` is the text actually sent to the TTS: pronunciation respellings ('Neuroster'→'Nurrohster' = nur-OH-ster, 'garrison'→'garrisun', 're-search', 'e-volve', 'colony'→'col-un-ee' — all verified via eSpeak IPA) and requested pauses as sentence breaks; `vo` stays the human-readable line.

scenes.vo: This is Neuroster, a world-building colony game where all of your workers happen to be hamsters.
scenes.say: This is Nurrohster, a world-building col-un-ee game where all of your workers, happen to be hamsters.

scenes.vo: You start by building a colony in a living world. Pick a biome you like — and your first few hamsters get right to work, digging, and settling in.
scenes.say: You start by building a col-un-ee in a living world. Pick a bi-ohm you like. And your first few hamsters get right to work, digging, and settling in.

scenes.vo: Then you build — you automate — and thrive.
scenes.say: Then you build. You automate. And thrive.

scenes.vo: You'll mine materials and refine them — grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops. And once the toil is automated, the whole colony really comes alive.
scenes.say: You'll mine materials and refine them. Grow the settlement with farms, mills, depots and workshops. And once the toil is automated, the whole col-un-ee really comes alive.

scenes.vo: Every rodent here is a somebody. They've got names, families, and jobs to do. It's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.
scenes.say: Every rodent here is a somebody. They've got names, families, and jobs to do. It's up to you to keep them fed, watered, curious and healthy.

scenes.vo: Out here, the wild is always watching.
scenes.say: Out here, the wild is always watching.

scenes.vo: Predators, disasters, rival factions. So you'll raise a garrison, research new skills, and evolve your rodents to handle whatever comes.
scenes.say: Predators, disasters, rival factions. So you'll raise a garrisun, re-search new skills, and e-volve your rodents to handle whatever comes.

scenes.vo: Neuroster. It's your colony — and your world. So grab a shovel, and start digging.
scenes.say: Nurrohster. It's your col-un-ee. And your world. So grab a shovel, and start digging.
